expect.en: to manage, to get done; to create

en: to manage, to get done; to create
src: The card leads with «manage» (A2, both examples), and all four synonyms were the «create» sense, so the synonym drill asked for erschaffen. hinkriegen («ich krieg das hin» = «ich schaffe das») and bewältigen are the «manage» sense; erschaffen stays for «create». gestalten, formen and hervorbringen are «shape, produce», looser than either.

expect.def: to create, to call into being; to create, make, form, shape

def: to manage something, to get it done (weak: schaffte, hat geschafft); meaning to create, it is strong (schuf, hat geschaffen)

de: Die Firma hat hundert neue Arbeitsplätze geschaffen.
en: The company has created a hundred new jobs.
